news.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC

news.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
news.summary: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

news.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
news.summary: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals

news.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
news.summary: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

news.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
